name: GridCast
title: Probabilistic load forecasting for campus-scale energy systems.
abstract: A 96-hour forecasting system for university microgrids. A temporal-convolutional backbone produces quantile forecasts, recalibrated with conformal prediction and validated against four years of interval data — then served through a lightweight inference API.

name: CarePath
title: Simulation and optimization for outpatient care logistics.
abstract: A discrete-event model of referral routing, appointment capacity, and no-show behaviour across partner clinics — paired with a mixed-integer scheduler. Pilot scenarios reduced modelled median wait time by 18%.

name: CausalTwin
title: A reproducible engine for observational policy evaluation.
abstract: Doubly robust estimators, negative controls, and sensitivity bounds behind one scikit-learn-compatible interface — built for studies that must survive scrutiny, not just a single notebook.
